basic_info.description: Enjoy city living at the Metropolitan on Rincon Hill. Residence 305 is a stylishly upgraded one bedroom urban home that showcases an open floor plan and lots of light through large picture windows. The residence has been updated with wood flooring, custom lighting and more. Finishes include: granite countertops, Bosch appliances, gas cooking, marble bath finishes and a deep soaking tub. The Metropolitan is a full service high rise community with lifestyle amenities that include: a front desk with 24/7 lobby attendants, a Self Parking Spot, additional storage, a 3500+ state of the art fitness center, an indoor pool center with sauna, hot tub & showers, a fully equipped club room with double sided fireplace and catering kitchen, a theater with HD viewing, a business center, a conference room and a roof top entertaining terrace with BBQ. The Metropolitan is located in San Francisco's South Beach neighborhood, walking distance to the Financial District, the Embarcadero, the Ferry Building, Union Square, fine dining, entertainment, Oracle Ballpark and Chase Center. You're close to shopping and steps to tech bus routes. The Metropolitan is built on bedrock. Live on Rincon Hill, in San Francisco's newest and most vibrant neighborhood.
